evidence: Films grown at 150 °C had a very low density (3.39 g cm -3) which can be related to the porosity of these films. The density of the films grown at 500°C was higher (3.76 g cm-3), approaching the density of bulk anatase (3.84 g cm -3). Refractive indices at a wavelength of 580 nm were observed to increase steadily from 2.4 (150 °C) to 2.6 (450 °C). Film thicknesses had no effect on the refractive index.
